snippet.title: Cartoon Crime Gameplay – GTA-Style Indie Open World Game | TPS & Top-Down
snippet.description:
Here’s a look at some alpha gameplay from Cartoon Crime, an upcoming indie open-world crime game inspired by classic GTA-style games.

Wishlist Cartoon Crime on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057090/Cartoon_Crime/

In this gameplay, you’ll see some city exploration, driving, street fights, shootouts, police chases, and the option to switch between Third-Person and classic Top-Down views at any time.

Cartoon Crime is all about that old-school open-world crime game feel, with a colorful cartoon style and plenty of freedom to explore the city and cause some chaos.

Some of the features:
• Third-Person and Top-Down camera modes
• Open-world city exploration
• Cars and driving
• Melee combat and shootouts
• Police chases and wanted levels
• Bodyguards
• Missions and side activities
• Mini-games
• Character progression
• Colorful cartoon-style visuals

This footage was recorded with the invincibility cheat enabled so I could show more of the driving, combat, exploration, and police action without constantly stopping.

Cartoon Crime is currently in development and is coming to Steam Early Access.

If you like indie games, open-world crime games, or old-school GTA-style gameplay, consider adding Cartoon Crime to your Steam wishlist.

Which view do you prefer Third Person or Top-Down?
